details: 主办腾讯首届 TGIdeas 移动前端峰会，并在 tgideas.github.io/motion 开源 MOTION.JS 移动应用组件库。
创建京东 `凹凸实验室` 技术品牌（aotu.io），构建品牌运营生态，包括：官网、微信公众号、Github 组织、掘金账号、凹凸公开课、Taro 项目。
主办凹凸极客沙龙（geeks.aotu.io），在业内传播技术影响力。
开源 AT-UI Vue.js UI 框架（github.com/AT-UI/at-ui），2.2K Star，现已整合至 Taro-UI 项目。
开源 ELF HTML5 构建工具（elf.aotu.io），466 Star。
开源基于 Github Issue 的 Gitalk 评论组件（gitalk.github.io），6K+ Star。
探索凹凸实验室的技术变现，策划凹凸小书（books.aotu.io），在掘金上发布京东首个付费的掘金小册《大厂H5开发实战手册》。
组织和评审美团闪购技术部 23 年《闪耀技术培训》供应链领域的课程。
Hosted Tencent's first TGIdeas Mobile Frontend Summit and open-sourced the MOTION.JS mobile application component library at tgideas.github.io/motion.

Created JD.com's `Aotu Lab` technology brand (aotu.io), building a brand operation ecosystem including official website, WeChat public account, Github organization, Juejin account, Aotu public courses, and Taro project.
Hosted Aotu Geek Salon (geeks.aotu.io), spreading technical influence within the industry.
Open-sourced AT-UI Vue.js UI framework (github.com/AT-UI/at-ui), 2.2K Stars, now integrated into Taro-UI project.
Open-sourced ELF HTML5 build tool (elf.aotu.io), 466 Stars.
Open-sourced Gitalk comment component based on Github Issues (gitalk.github.io), 6K+ Stars.
Explored Aotu Lab's technology monetization, planned Aotu Books (books.aotu.io), and published JD.com's first paid Juejin booklet "Enterprise H5 Development Practical Manual" on Juejin platform.
Organized and reviewed Meituan Flash Purchase Technology Department's 2023 "Shining Technology Training" supply chain domain courses.
